name: Apothecary Renferrel
summary: At the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel advances Forsaken alchemy in Silverpine Forest. He studies the region’s corrupted wildlife and undead threats, and travelers help gather volatile reagents and investigate Scourge remnants.

sections.title: The Sepulcher's Alchemist
sections.body: At the Sepulcher, Renferrel leads field research for the Royal Apothecary Society in Silverpine Forest. The society’s grand laboratories and high leadership are in Undercity, while he handles the work in the field. He secures native biological specimens, refines potent concoctions, and studies the grim ecology along Lordaeron’s western border.

sections.title: Investigating Rot Hide and Scourge
sections.body: Renferrel studies the Rot Hide gnolls and rogue undead in Silverpine. Blood and tissue samples help him examine the lingering touch of the plague and the necromantic forces binding local monsters. His investigations bring him into conflict with Thule Ravenclaw, a powerful Scourge necromancer near the ruins of Fenris Isle.

faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel works for the Royal Apothecary Society from the Sepulcher, the main Forsaken outpost in Silverpine Forest. He studies local beasts, plague variations, and enemy forces to brew concoctions and secure the region for Queen Sylvanas.

faq.q: What does Renferrel research in Silverpine?
faq.answer: Renferrel develops new plagues and venomous mixtures, known broadly as a 'Recipe for Death'. He asks travelers to gather grizzly bear hearts, Rot Hide gnoll ichor, and other biological components so he can test and refine lethal concoctions.

faq.q: What is his connection to the Rot Hide gnolls?
faq.answer: Renferrel studies the corrupted ichor of the Rot Hide gnolls. His initial tests detect warlock and necromantic magic, so he sends a sample to Bethor Iceshard in Undercity for further study.

faq.q: Why does Renferrel target Thule Ravenclaw?
faq.answer: Renferrel investigates the magic behind the Rot Hide gnolls and seeks Bethor Iceshard’s help identifying its source. The investigation leads toward the threats on Fenris Isle.

faq.q: Where does Renferrel send adventurers after Silverpine?
faq.answer: After his initial research and the local threats are addressed, Renferrel sends seasoned travelers southeast to Hillsbrad Foothills. This connects the Sepulcher’s frontier efforts with broader Forsaken operations in Lordaeron.

faq.q: What is the Royal Apothecary Society?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society is the Forsaken’s scientific and alchemical branch, founded under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. Based in Undercity, its researchers develop new poisons, seek to resist natural decay, and craft a plague capable of eradicating the Scourge.

angles.text: As an undead, you know the Forsaken’s ruthless drive to survive. Renferrel turns Lordaeron’s native flora and fauna into weapons to secure a future for the freed undead.
As a member of the Horde, you may find Renferrel’s biological experiments gruesome. His intelligence gathering against the Scourge helps protect Horde territories from northern incursions.
